invariants: Validate the complete configured array before publishing; reject empty exact IDs, mutually exclusive fresh/resume IDs and duplicate exact identities.
Launcher configuredAgentIdentities replaces both identity keys only on matching config labels. Fresh identities use label-session-UUID; explicit resume waits for sessionPersistence.
Exact IDs restore existing materialized history or create only after absence is confirmed. A same-ID lifecycle must leave both registries before replacement.
The labeled agentLoop.resume effect owns the exact deferred child disposer. Disposing a factory aborts startup observers; late prepared values release without publication.
An inactive old factory can be replaced; its cleanup only clears its own registry binding.
Startup errors and sync/async observer errors are contained, preserving the original error object and tolerating unrenderable string conversions.
identity: Configured row label is distinct from exact Session/Agent identity. Owner and replacement are exact factory instances.
ownership: ConfiguredStartup tracks asynchronous work; FactoryTransaction owns unpublished preparation and live lifetime. Returned Fiber/FiberHandle.dispose is resolved to the exact registered parent effect wrapper.
ordering: Validate/override -> create or deferred resume -> reservation/setup -> paired registry publication -> driver. Reload waits for both registry removals and persistence retirement.
errors: Missing explicit resume reports failure and never creates; exact restore only falls back after list confirms no stored ID. Existing corruption and index failures report config-start-failed. Reports cease once factory ownership is inactive.
cancellation: Factory abort stops drain/index observers without cancelling external work. Existing transaction races observe/release late preparations. Listener removal happens in finally.
adaptation: Python 3.8 startup tasks replace JS Promise tracking; a fresh configured create completes through plugin async initialization. Seven paired scenarios compare selected identity, history, failure and effect-tree outcomes, not all AgentLoop behavior or full driver transcript parity. Full settings/maxParallelToolCalls policy, system-prompt variable integration and complete profile/launcher journeys remain outside this bounded contract.
